text:
maya (ml eng): new model intake — Zephyr-13B-v2 candidate. need to triage perf + quantization before we greenlight for dedicated pools
sam (bench): putting it on the intake board. quick questions: primary SLOs we care about? p95 latency under 120ms for 1-token interactive? or throughput for batch workloads?
jin (infra): primary ask from infra: memory footprint and KV cache growth with ctx len. if int8/int4 quant changes alignment we need to know host memory and GPU allocation.
maya (ml eng): typo in name^ — yes, both. For PLG use-cases we care about interactive latency (p50/p95) at small batch sizes (1-4) and throughput for batch inference (batches 8-32) on Dedicated. Also ctx sweep up to 16k to verify mem blowups.
sam (bench): plan: run latency sweep at batch sizes [1,2,4], ctx lengths [512,2048,4096,8192,16384], quant modes [fp16, int8, int4] and throughput sweep at batch sizes [8,16,32] for tokens/sec. I'll capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, CUDA mem, and peak host RSS.
rolf (prodops): add checklist items: 1) cold-start KV cache time; 2) behaviour under continuous streaming + prefix caching; 3) fallback correctness to smaller model if OOM; 4) deterministic seeds for quality checks.
maya (ml eng): also run small eval set for quality regression per quant mode — rouge/bleu-ish classification/regression probes. if int4 drops >1.5% e.g. on helix-q we mark for review.
sam (bench): putting a smoke command in thread:
```bash
python infra/bench/run.py --model zephyr-13b-v2 --devices 1 --batches 1,2,4,8,16,32 --ctx 512,2048,4096,8192,16384 --quant fp16,int8,int4 --measure p50,p95,p99,throughput --output ./runs/zephyr-v2-sweep.json
```
sam (bench): note: make sure to set --warmup 200 and --rep 10 for stability.
jin (infra): recommended GPU config for Dedicated dev: 48GB A40 equiv for fp16/int8, and test int4 on a 80GB to catch KV edge cases. I'll reserve a node for next Wed.
maya (ml eng): prioritization: customer signals + model novelty -> mark as P1 for onboarding (needs Dedicated perf profile) if we pass latency and <10% cost increase vs baseline 13B-quant. Otherwise P2.
rolf (prodops): ownership: sam owns perf runs and artifacts; jin owns infra node and logs; maya owns quality regressions and acceptance criteria. I'll create the rollout ticket and link to this thread.
maya (ml eng): any framing for alerts? perf-bot: please add automatic regression alert if p95 increases by >15% or throughput drops 20% vs baseline.
perf-bot: noted. hook created: /alerts/perf-regressions/zephyr-v2.
sam (bench): quick question: do we want to run continuous batching profile (simulate bursty web traffic) or steady-state throughput only?
maya (ml eng): both. continuous burst simulation for 0-100 rps with realistic inter-arrival times, and steady-state for long-tail jobs. capture queueing delay percentiles.
jin (infra): will collect nvprof and nsys traces for the worst-case ctx to find kernel hotspots. will also dump CUDA mem maps pre/post run.
maya (ml eng): timeline: smoke tonight (int8 fp16 small ctx), full sweep Wed-Fri, preliminary results by Monday. If any OOM or severe quality regression, pause Dedicated onboarding.
sam (bench): ack — will post run artifacts to /runs/zephyr-v2 and a short summary thread with charts (latency vs batch/ctx, throughput tokens/sec, GPU mem).
rolf (prodops): tagging: @eng-oncall if we see >3 OOMs in a row on a node. also include run IDs in ticket.
maya (ml eng): thanks all. assigning follow-ups: sam -> perf artifacts, jin -> infra logs/traces, maya -> eval pass/fail. I'll review Monday and decide rollout. :white_check_mark:
